snippet.title: MAGE Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
MAGE is An action-packed 2D projectile fighter inspired by controller couch party classics. Master one of 21 unique Mages across over 200 maps in a simple but customizable and deep experience for up to 4 players local or online.
Wishlist the game on Steam Now! 

Trailer made by James Ketley

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459080/MAGE_Mega_Awesome_Gregarious_Encounters/
